newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HUNTER DOUGLAS OPTIMISTIC FOR REST 1997.
newsitem.headline: HUNTER DOUGLAS OPTIMISTIC FOR REST 1997.

text.p: Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas said on Wednesday it was optimistic over its prospects for the rest of the 1997 fiscal year.

"Hunter Douglas continues to look at the balance of the year with optimism based on the excellent performance in North America, continued strong growth in Asia and Latin America and an expected pick-up in profits in Europe and Australia," the firm said in a statement with its half-year results.
The group reported first-half net profits of 76.3 million guilders, up some 21 percent from the same period of 1996. Turnover rose around 15 percent to 1.28 billion guilders from 1.11 billion.
The profit rise reflected better results in North America, Asia and Latin America as well as lower interest costs and the stronger dollar over the period, the company said.
